paragraphs.text: The Desert Nomads of Rabiah are wanderers of the dunes, experts at surviving in that deadly climate. They cover most of their bodies with cloth to protect themselves from the burning light of the sun and wield many types of weapons, including spears, daggers, and crossbows.

The most famous member of these nomads was the Red Taysir , a future Planeswalker who lived in the Karun Desert . There, he encountered his soul brother, the Black-Green Apprentice Taysir, and the Sorceress Queen Nailah . Apprentice Taysir gave Nomad Taysir the Ring of Maruf , which he used to leave his version of Rabiah behind forever.
